# A09-S99: Correspondence

Correspondence extract. Omissions are marked […].

[…]

Here was your email concerning Kunstfonden – yes, that is really a pity. But let's see if we can find a better exhibition space and other funds – what had you applied for and may I see the application?

[…]

May I also see the application to the municipality?
I have not received any links – and I have heard two P1 programs where you were not involved ha ha, so I would like to hear them.
I think we should talk about how we get the voter declarations and how we get a press strategy laid out so we can really push it further.

[…]
